faq.a: Growth provides the complete self-service Seopotion software workflow. Business includes the same software plus human review of up to 10 selected Seopotion-generated articles per month. It does not include agency campaign management, human-written-from-scratch content, backlink outreach, paid advertising or external marketing distribution.
faq.q: What is the difference between Growth and Business?

faq.a: Growth includes 30 articles per month, website and business analysis, topic and keyword research, a content calendar, SEO-oriented article generation, internal linking, AI-assisted images, relevant YouTube videos, the article editor, WordPress publishing and optional automatic publishing.
Yes. Connect WordPress, review and edit an article in Seopotion, then send it to WordPress according to your configured draft or publishing settings.
Yes. Generated articles remain editable in Seopotion. You can review them before publishing manually, or enable automatic publishing for future generated articles when you want that workflow.
faq.q: Can I review articles before they are published?

faq.a: Yes. Growth includes AI-assisted images and relevant YouTube video insertion for generated articles.

You can pay monthly or annually. Growth costs $60 per month or $540 per year. Business costs $400 per month or $3,600 per year. Every initial subscription purchase includes a 30-day money-back guarantee.
No. Seopotion does not currently offer a free trial. Initial purchases are covered by the 30-day money-back guarantee described in the Refund Policy.
